Synopsis:
    Danish-Egyptian director May el-Toukhy, the sole woman directing a fiction film among 21 Golden Lion contenders at Venice, highlights structural gender inequality in the film industry. Her film "Woman Unknown," set in post-WWII Denmark, explores female invisibility and stigma. She notes financing remains harder for women directors, and that post-MeToo progress appears to be reversing.
